name: prestruct-shapes
description: File checks over a site baked by the prestruct engine: the SSR marker the engine writes (data-server-rendered="true") is present on every page that carries an app mount and absent from the hand-authored shell pages (the 404 contract - a bare presence check would false-positive there), the deploy-id meta is one build across the whole tree (a page left behind by a partial bake is a stale-deploy lie), og:url agrees with rel=canonical per page, and the shell template's placeholder tokens never survive the inject-brand pass into dist. Zero network, zero HTML execution - attribute reads only.
